name: nextc-hud
description: Heads-up display mod: an always-on row above the prompt (context, compactions, cost estimate, rate limits, agents, live runs) with /hud actions that prepare a /compact or a handoff in the prompt box, a project run monitor for builds, explores, ASO and kickoff runs (/hud watch), an autopilot run monitor (/autopilot-watch), an agents pane (/hud agents), a critical-review check that asks for the reviewer when a turn changed critical logic, a proof tracker that shows whether the code was checked after the last edit, a project pane (/hud project), skill and agent usage (/hud usage), lesson capture, a handoff written at the right moment, a build card, a done chime, a # task typeahead, session cost history (/hud costs) and a 'used this turn' line. It mostly observes; three optional parts do more: one small model call per turn that changed code, one follow-up message per prompt asking for a review or for proof, and one model pass that writes the handoff file.

always_on_row.title: Always-on session row
always_on_row.description: One row above the prompt: context used, compactions, cost estimate, rate limits, agents and live project runs. /hud off hides it for one session.

auto_watch.title: Open the run pane by itself
auto_watch.description: When a build, explore, ASO or kickoff run starts in this project, open its read-only pane without /hud watch. The pane collapses to one line once the run's outcome has left the row and expands again for the next run; it is never closed for you. Needs the row on.

auto_agents.title: Open the agents pane by itself
auto_agents.description: When two or more agents are working, or a team is running, open the agents pane without /hud agents: who is on which task, for how long, and how far along. It collapses to one line when the last agent finishes and is never closed for you.

review_reminder.title: Critical review reminder
review_reminder.description: The toast naming critical files with no critical-reviewer pass, shown when the follow-up is off, could not be sent, or was already sent once for this prompt. The row shows the count either way.

critical_check.title: Check each turn's changes for critical logic
critical_check.description: After a turn that changed code, one small model call (Haiku by default, a fraction of a cent) reads the changed code and says which files hold critical logic: auth, access rules, payments, user data, secrets, concurrency, schema. Off: only the path pattern decides. Never runs in claude -p or autopilot runs.

critical_followup.title: When critical changes have no review
critical_followup.description: auto: follow nextc-core's ask_level (less: send; normal, or nextc-core not installed: fill). send: the mod sends one message asking Claude to run the critical-reviewer, once per prompt of yours. fill: it puts that message in the prompt box for you to send. off: a toast only.

critical_model.title: Model for the critical check
critical_model.description: The model alias or id the check uses. Empty uses haiku.

critical_paths.title: Critical path pattern
critical_paths.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against a file's path inside the project that marks an edit as critical whatever the check says (and alone when the check is off or fails). Empty uses the built-in list of whole words: auth, login, session, password, permission, role, rls, policy, payment, billing, purchase, subscription, entitlement, checkout, wallet, secret, crypto, migration, schema, access/refresh/api/jwt tokens, and .sql files.

proof_check.title: Track proof of verification
proof_check.description: Follow which checks ran after the last code edit (analyzers, type checks, linters, test runs). The row shows 'not checked', 'checked' or 'check failed', and /hud proof lists the checks. No model call.

proof_followup.title: When code changed and nothing was checked
proof_followup.description: auto: follow nextc-core's ask_level (less: send; normal, or nextc-core not installed: fill). send: the mod sends one message asking Claude to verify the work and show the commands and results; it shares the one message per prompt with the critical-review ask. fill: it puts that message in the prompt box. off: a toast only.

show_proof_line.title: Show the proof line
show_proof_line.description: Under an answer that changed code or ran a check, one line built from the commands that actually ran: 'checked · flutter analyze ✓', 'check failed · …' or 'not checked · 4 code files changed'.

verify_commands.title: Extra check commands
verify_commands.description: A regular expression matching this project's own check commands (for example a custom validate script), counted as a check besides the built-in analyzers and test runners. Empty adds none.

upload_warning.title: Warn before a build with unreviewed or unchecked changes
upload_warning.description: When a build or upload command starts while critical files are unreviewed or code has not been checked since the last edit, one toast says so. It never blocks the build.

lesson_capture.title: Offer to save a correction as a lesson
lesson_capture.description: When a prompt reads like a correction ('no, …', 'you should …'), the row offers [ save lesson ] for three turns; pressing it puts a /learn-eval request in the prompt box.

auto_handoff.title: Write the handoff when context reaches 'act now'
auto_handoff.description: At the 'act now' threshold, write .claude/handoff.md in the background from the conversation itself (one extra model pass over the session's transcript, billed like a turn that reads the whole context; the previous handoff is kept as handoff.prev.md), so a fresh start is /clear then /session-handoff resume. Read the file before resuming: it is model text built from the whole conversation.

auto_handoff_max_tokens.title: Largest context for the automatic handoff
auto_handoff_max_tokens.description: Above this many context tokens the handoff is not written automatically, because the pass re-reads the whole conversation; /hud handoff write does it on request.

build_card.title: Build card under a build command
build_card.description: One dim line under a fastlane, flutter build, gradlew, xcodebuild or Unity batch-mode command: the build's version and step from the buildlog, how long the command has run, and how it ended.

done_toasts.title: Done toasts
done_toasts.description: A toast when a long turn ends, a build or pipeline run finishes, or a long stretch of agent work ends.

done_sound.title: Done sound
done_sound.description: A short chime with the same events as the done toasts. macOS only: other systems play nothing.

done_after_seconds.title: A turn is long after (seconds)
done_after_seconds.description: A turn or a stretch of agent work that took at least this long gets the done toast and sound. From 10 to 3600; a smaller value counts as 10.

task_typeahead.title: #task typeahead
task_typeahead.description: Typing # in the prompt box lists the open tasks from docs/tasks.md; taking one writes its text into the prompt.

cost_history.title: Session history for /hud costs
cost_history.description: Keep each session's project name, cost estimate, compactions and agent count in this mod's own store (a JSON file Claude Code keeps in its configuration folder), so /hud costs can show the last 7 days by project. Nothing leaves this machine.

heavy_percent.title: Heavy at context %
heavy_percent.description: The row turns to 'heavy' (warning colour, two actions) once context passes this share of the window. From 1 to 100; a value outside is clamped.

act_percent.title: Act now at context %
act_percent.description: The row says 'act now' once context passes this share of the window. From 1 to 100; a value outside is clamped.

heavy_tokens.title: Heavy at tokens
heavy_tokens.description: Also 'heavy' once context passes this many tokens, whatever the window (useful on a 1M window). 0 turns this off.

act_compactions.title: Act now after compactions
act_compactions.description: The row says 'act now' from this many compactions in one session.

coach_toasts.title: Coach toasts
coach_toasts.description: One toast per threshold crossing per session (heavy, act now, repeated compactions). /hud coach off silences them for one session.

toasts_when_hidden.title: Coach toasts while the row is hidden
toasts_when_hidden.description: Also toast when the row is off, hidden or collapsed. Off: a hidden row stays quiet.

show_used_line.title: Show the 'used this turn' line
show_used_line.description: Under each answer, one line naming the skills and subagents that turn used. Nothing is shown for a turn that used neither.

autopilot_toasts.title: Autopilot toasts
autopilot_toasts.description: While /autopilot-watch follows a run, a toast once when it ends, stalls, uses 80% of its decider calls, or has under 15% of its budget left.
